bigIdea: Our waits halved because the triage bot answers the easy third of tickets, so the next dollar should go to the bot, not to more agents.

beats.name: Context
beats.claim: Waiting was customers' top complaint in every survey last year.

beats.name: Data
beats.claim: Median first response fell from 9 hours to 4 after the triage bot launched in July.

beats.name: Insight
beats.claim: The bot resolves a third of tickets with no agent, which frees agents for the hard ones.

beats.name: Implication
beats.claim: Hiring agents for the same gain would cost three times as much.

beats.name: Action
beats.claim: Fund the bot's second phase and hold headcount flat.
